title: Include multiple releases from the same space in cross-space releases
description:
Jira Plans users can now include more than one release from the same Jira space in a cross-space release. This update to Jira Plans allows teams that manage multiple workstreams or components within a single space to accurately represent their release trains and coordinate work more effectively. To get started with this change: Open your plan in Jira.
